personalInfo.name: Roberto Abad Ramirez Nieves
personalInfo.title: Senior iOS Engineer
personalInfo.description: Senior iOS Engineer with 7+ years of experience building scalable, accessible, and high-performance mobile applications. Led feature development for the Wells Fargo iOS app serving millions of users, with deep expertise in SwiftUI, GraphQL, and modern iOS architecture.

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am a Senior Software Engineer with over 7 years of experience building high-impact digital products for banking, enterprise, and consumer applications, working in demanding environments across Mexico and Silicon Valley.

Throughout my career, I have delivered end-to-end solutions across the Apple ecosystem and the web, contributing to architecture design, robust UI implementation, backend service integration, and performance and quality optimization in large-scale codebases.

I am known for quickly adapting to different technology stacks and business domains, with hands-on experience in mobile development, frontend engineering, API consumption, GraphQL, accessibility, testing, CI/CD, and close collaboration with design, product, and technical stakeholders.
